explanation: Matches the displayed relation on erdosproblems.com/1169: ω₁² ↛ (ω₁², 3)². OrdinalRamsey α β γ says every red/blue colouring of pairs of α has a red clique of order type β or a blue clique of order type γ, so its negation is the negative arrow. The page's stray 'for all finite k' is explained in the docstring and covered by the separate variant. It is correctly marked open in ZFC.
